steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Direct Channel — No Dedicated Group Yet Vikram Patel (VPatel Steel Centre) is a customer who sends enquiries directly to Amit Joshi's personal WhatsApp number. screens.description: Two-Message Pattern — Forward + Tag Amit pastes Vikram's requirement as a forwarded message in BOS, then immediately replies to it with @zoai vpatel-steel-centre enquiry . steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Identical Engine — Source Doesn't Matter Once an enquiry is in the Google Sheet, the automation pipeline is exactly the same whether it came from a dedicated customer group or a direct DM. The only difference downstream is the delivery channel: this customer gets Email + WABA instead of a group notification.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Quote Approved — ZoAi Triggers Multi-Channel Delivery Suresh approves QT-2026-01130 in the admin portal. Sheet rows 4–5 update to "Quote Approved" with amounts ₹3,60,000 + ₹1,80,000 (total ₹5,40,000). ZoAi detects the status change and simultaneously sends the quote to the BOS group, Vikram's email, and Vikram's WhatsApp via WABA.
